title: Lab results
loadFailed: The lab results could not be loaded.
none: No lab results on this visit.
interpretation: {flag, select, N {Normal} L {Low} H {High} LL {Critically low} HH {Critically high} A {Abnormal} other {}}
attached: Lab result attached. The patient sees it once a practitioner releases it.
pdfFailedAfterAttach: The result was attached, but its PDF was not. Attach the PDF again on the result.
rowIncomplete: Each value needs its test and its value.
unitWithoutNumber: A unit goes with a number. Remove the unit or type the value as a number.
notReleased: Not released: the patient does not see it yet
releaseQuestion: Release this result to the patient?

releaseEffect.defaultMessage: The patient sees it in the app, and it cannot be changed after.

invalid: Check the result: it needs a title, each value its test and its value, and a unit goes with a number.
notPdf: The file is not a PDF.
notFound: The result cannot be attached: the visit is not one you may see, or its patient has no active consent to care at this clinic.
forbidden: You cannot change this visit’s lab results.
alreadyReleased: This result was released already. The list is updated.
changed: This result changed since it was read. The list is updated.
